tools.name: hetu_read_blueprint
tools.title: 读取设定集 / Read story bible
tools.description: 读取当前或固定修订的作者设定集。Read the author's current or fixed story bible revision.

tools.name: hetu_write_draft
tools.title: 提交待审草稿 / Submit draft
tools.description: 保存调用方提供的文本，等待作者审核；不覆盖正式正文，不自动生成或检查。Save supplied text for author review; no generation, automatic validation or direct publication.

tools.name: hetu_extract_plot
tools.title: 整理剧情 / Extract plot
tools.description: 从固定原文提取结构候选；覆盖不足保留 partial，需要作者确认。Extract structural candidates from fixed source revisions; partial coverage requires author review.

tools.name: hetu_build_drama_skeleton
tools.title: 建立短剧骨架 / Build drama skeleton
tools.description: 从固定剧情整理分集场次，不生成台词、动作或镜头描述。Organize episodes and scenes from fixed plot evidence; no dialogue, action or shot generation.

tools.name: hetu_validate_blueprint
tools.title: 执行一致性检查 / Validate consistency
tools.description: 检查固定剧情修订；问题和未覆盖范围是报告结果，不是工具故障。Validate a fixed plot revision; findings and uncovered premises are report outcomes, not tool failures.

tools.name: hetu_list_workspace
tools.title: 查看授权工作区 / List workspace
tools.description: 读取启动时绑定的单一工作区和内容包。Read the single workspace and packages authorized at server startup. Discover documents and review feedback through resources.

tools.name: hetu_validate_draft
tools.title: 检查待审草稿 / Validate draft
tools.description: 检查固定草稿或其人工校正剧情并保存审核证据；不能批准草稿。Validate a fixed draft or its author-corrected plot and save review evidence; cannot approve drafts.

tools.name: hetu_commit_snapshot
tools.title: 准备或提交版本快照 / Prepare or commit snapshot
tools.description: 准备固定文件、HEAD与提交身份，返回pending；仅可执行已经由作者在本机批准的同一快照。不能自行批准、初始化、切分支、推送或执行hooks。Prepare fixed files, HEAD and identity with pending status; execution requires the author’s matching local approval. Cannot approve, initialize, switch branches, push or execute hooks.

tools.name: hetu_read_creative_task
tools.title: 读取本次创作任务 / Read creative task
tools.description: 读取连接绑定的固定任务、授权原文及参考候选；不能遍历其他章节、作品或任务。Read only the bound task, fixed authorized sources and reference candidates; no access to other documents, books or tasks.

tools.name: hetu_submit_creative_result
tools.title: 提交创作参考 / Submit creative references
tools.description: 提交固定任务的独立候选；改稿只接受允许范围内的 UTF-8 patches。不覆盖作者正文、不采纳或定稿。Submit independent candidates for the fixed task; revisions require UTF-8 patches within edit_scope. Cannot save author documents, adopt or finalize.

tools.name: hetu_open_task_view
tools.title: 查看任务局部选择 / Read task selection view
tools.description: 比较本任务参考方案。支持 MCP Apps 的宿主可展示局部选择面板；其他宿主返回同一任务数据。保存只记录偏好，不采纳正文或定稿。Compare references for this task, with an optional MCP Apps selection view. Other hosts receive the same task data. Preferences do not adopt or finalize content.

tools.name: hetu_save_task_selection
tools.title: 保存参考偏好 / Save reference preference
tools.description: 仅保存候选偏好和意见；不代表作者采纳、创建作品、选用封面或确认定稿。Save candidate preferences and comments only; never adopts text, creates a book, selects its cover or finalizes.

tools.name: hetu_list_resources
tools.title: 查询资料 / List references
tools.description: 查询获权文字资料摘要，按分类、标签与状态分页。List authorized reference summaries with filters and pagination.

tools.name: hetu_read_resource
tools.title: 读取资料 / Read reference
tools.description: 读取当前获权或固定修订资料；不自动使用最新版本替换任务基线。Read an authorized fixed or current reference without silently replacing task baselines.

tools.name: hetu_create_resource
tools.title: 新增资料候选 / Create reference candidate
tools.description: 仅资料任务可新增草稿，不写设定集或自动采用。Create a draft only within an authorized reference task; never changes canon or adopts it.

tools.name: hetu_update_resource
tools.title: 维护资料候选 / Update reference candidate
tools.description: 在明确任务内以 CAS 维护未采用资料，拒绝更新正式记录。Update authorized unadopted references using CAS; cannot alter adopted records.

tools.name: hetu_list_drama_projects
tools.title: 查询短剧项目 / List drama projects
tools.description: 分页查询本作品的原创与改编项目。List original and adaptation projects within this work.

tools.name: hetu_read_drama_project
tools.title: 读取短剧项目 / Read drama project
tools.description: 读取项目及有序写作分集，骨架规划单独保存。Read a project and its ordered writing episodes; planning skeletons remain separate.

tools.name: hetu_read_drama_episode
tools.title: 读取分集 / Read episode
tools.description: 读取稳定写作分集及文档引用，集号由项目目录计算。Read a stable writing episode and its document reference; episode order comes from the project.

tools.name: hetu_inspect_collaboration
tools.title: 检查河图洛书接入 / Inspect connection
tools.description: 检查实际工具与合同，不读取作品；先检查，再用作者提供的任务引用打开。Inspect actual tools and contracts without reading books; open the author-provided task locator next.

tools.name: hetu_open_collaboration_task
tools.title: 打开创作任务 / Open creative task
tools.description: 只打开作者已授权的确切任务，返回当前固定引用和任务能力；不扫描书库、不扩大授权。Open the exact author-authorized task and return its fixed reference and capabilities; no library scan or permission expansion.

tools.name: hetu_read_task_operation
tools.title: 查询任务原操作 / Recover task operation
tools.description: 沿当前获权任务的原键查询保存结果，不重复执行写入。Read the original operation in the exact authorized task without repeating a write.

tools.name: hetu_create_working_copy
tools.title: 新建参考稿 / Create working copy
tools.description: 保存本任务可持续修改的参考稿，不创建正式章节或分集。Create an editable task reference, never an author document.

tools.name: hetu_read_working_copy
tools.title: 读取参考稿 / Read working revision
tools.description: 读取指定的不可变修订及当前头，不自动切到最新稿。Read the exact saved revision and current head.

tools.name: hetu_list_working_copies
tools.title: 查看任务参考稿 / List working copies
tools.description: 只列出本任务参考稿及当前修订。List only this task’s working references.

tools.name: hetu_save_working_copy
tools.title: 保存参考稿 / Save working revision
tools.description: 按完整 expected 保存新修订；改稿只接受获准选区补丁。Save with CAS; revision tasks accept only authorized patches.

tools.name: hetu_save_task_feedback
tools.title: 保存修改意见 / Save task feedback
tools.description: 保存固定成果的公开意见，不采纳、不扩权、不启动 Agent。Save public feedback without adoption, authorization or agent execution.

tools.name: hetu_list_task_feedback
tools.title: 读取修改意见 / Read task feedback
tools.description: 读取作者公开意见与成果引用，成果自报已处理不代表作者验收。Read public feedback and resulting references; reported handling is not author acceptance.

tools.name: hetu_list_task_context
tools.title: 查看任务资料目录 / List task context
tools.description: 列出已授权的固定修订，不内联原文。List authorized fixed sources without full text.

tools.name: hetu_read_task_context
tools.title: 读取固定资料片段 / Read fixed context
tools.description: 按 UTF-8 字节范围读取已授权原文，不跟随当前版本。Read bounded UTF-8 ranges from authorized fixed revisions.

tools.name: hetu_search_task_context
tools.title: 检索固定资料 / Search fixed context
tools.description: 仅在本任务固定资料中检索原文，返回位置及覆盖情况。Search only this task’s fixed sources with locations and coverage.

tools.name: hetu_list_models

tools.description: 读取当前账号的文字或图片模型目录。每次携带固定 task_ref；作者批准内容和费用前不得执行，未知结果沿原 plan_id 查询。

tools.description: 读取本任务的模型计划及作者批准状态。每次携带固定 task_ref；作者批准内容和费用前不得执行，未知结果沿原 plan_id 查询。
